patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Mom) He's had a cold, and since last night he's been tugging his right ear, crying, and running a fever. He finally fell asleep on me but wakes up fussy.
presentation.triageNote: 3-year-old male with a recent cold who developed fever, fussiness, and persistent pulling at his right ear overnight. The right tympanic membrane appears red and bulging.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this stable middle-ear infection requires examination, pain control, and a prescription but no counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This child has a typical middle-ear infection after an upper-respiratory illness.
clinical.acuityReason: Fever, fussiness, ear pulling, and a bulging tympanic membrane support a localized process without mastoid, neurologic, or systemic complications.
teachingPoints: Pain control is an important part of treatment regardless of whether antibiotics are used.
Postauricular swelling, ear displacement, toxic appearance, or neurologic findings would raise concern for complications.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Examination, oral pain treatment, and an age-appropriate antibiotic plan would allow discharge with pediatric follow-up.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: on the clinic chair, tugging at his right ear
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 3-year-old boy, flushed, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: tugging at his right ear. Expression: fussy and teary. Clearly visible: a hand tugging the ear and flushed cheeks. No text, no logos.
